fixed.optimizer: native AdamW .9,.98,1e-8; bias and LayerNorm no decay; clip1; fullbatch; FP32

grid.beta_definition: local_coupling in both layers; not inverse logit temperature; no output weight normalization modification

criteria: test<=.10 continuously from first train99 for>=10000 saved-step span
first test>=.90; width from last initial low-platform sample positive and<half platform length

measure.primary: G11 effective second-layer/query15 rule power D=sum diagonal S, full uniform59^2 grid; LayerNorm after additive decomposition
measure.secondary: signed offdiag I; per-mode D, coherent D+I and raw D retained
measure.checkpoints: 0..100000 every500 full model optimizer RNG loader; history additionally1

anchor_gate.full_gate: Same strict label/reason, t_mem/t_low_end/t90 within1000 steps, final test difference<=.01, mean absolute test curve error<=.02 and maximum<=.10; parameter exactness separately reported. If failure stop and investigate, do not silently relax.

analysis.cell: 3/3 strict G, mixed1/3 or2/3, 0/3; show allseed curves and finite100k outcomes
analysis.boundary: retain possible bounded Grokking band and multiple/reentrant transitions; no forced single monotone line; seedwise crossing brackets, stable3/3 versus0/3 brackets; mixed intervals unresolved
analysis.ratio: Plot all seeds vs wd/beta^2. Compare fixed k=2, free exponent k and 2D quadratic logistic with fixed ridge and leave-one-beta-out loss. Also test overlap of ratio-transformed empirical boundary brackets. Do not call unique x values exact collapse.
analysis.D: align strict G by own t50; pre=lastinitialtest<=.10, post=firsttest>=.9,500-step grid. NonG is not automatically unordered. Separately report high-generalization nonG, partial, lowtest<=.10 and unlearned. Match adjacent beta/wd cells same seed at same absolute G window. Report delta D and fold, do not search D thresholds.
analysis.ordered_word: Descriptive rule organization only; no thermodynamic phase assertion.

refinement.rule: After complete basegrid, at each existing beta choose at most one geometric midpoint in wd of adjacent cells with a change in strict G fraction; prioritize brackets separating3/3 and0/3, then greatest fraction contrast, then closest to0.5, then smallest wd. Exactly same three seeds/topology/100k. If no fraction-change brackets, do not invent a boundary or extend indefinitely.

completion: Report all75 plus at most15 allowed refinement runs. Positive outcomes cannot be guaranteed. If still unresolved, give evidence and exact remaining gap; no further topology or seed expansion.
